verificationMethod: Each URL opened with an HTTP fetcher running outside Israel (Anthropic WebFetch) on 23 Oct 2026. Direct curl from the build sandbox is blocked by its egress policy, so exact HTTP status codes are usually unavailable; '4xx client error' = the site rejected the request; 'permission timeout' = URL could not be requested in this session and is UNVERIFIED.

fieldNotes.geo_blocked_israel_only: yes | no | unknown ('no' = worked from outside Israel)
